Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR around 1700 cm-1, also carbonyl carbon in 13C NMR around 190-220 ppm. Could use IR spectra tool to see carbonyl peaks. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons.

We need to know the sample's compound; maybe the environment has a sample loaded. Use ir_spectra tool (no args). Let's call it.
